name: explain-ladder
description: Re-explains a topic in a new form when the user still does not understand: STE prose, then an ASCII diagram, then a step-by-step HTML page (2D, or a 3D scene for topics with depth), then a narrated video.

interface.shortDescription: Re-explain a topic as a diagram, an HTML page, or a video
interface.longDescription: Re-explains a topic in a new form when the user still does not understand: STE prose, then an ASCII diagram, then a step-by-step HTML page (2D, or a 3D scene for topics with depth), then a narrated video.
